title: comarum palustre var. ambifaria
intro: Comarum palustre var. ambifaria, commonly known as Marsh Cinquefoil, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family, characterized by its pink or white flowers and broad leaves. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Cinquefoil are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Comarum palustre var. ambifaria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
